summary.text: Sarah Keyeski is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 14, based in Lodi, elected to the Senate in 2024.
She serves on the Agriculture and Revenue, Education, and Mental Health, Substance Abuse Prevention, Children and Families committees.

paragraphs.text: Keyeski was born in La Crosse, Wisconsin, on October 25, 1970, and is married with six children.
She graduated from Cashton High School in 1989, earned a B.A. from Luther College in 1993 and an M.A. from Northwestern University in 1996.
The Legislature's page lists her occupation as mental health counselor.
She is a member of the Sauk Prairie Healthcare Foundation executive board and the Lodi & Lake Wisconsin Chamber of Commerce, a former executive director of Lift Lodi, and a former Girl Scout leader.
She is also a member of the Council on Domestic Abuse and the Council on Tourism.
